description: This file defines the trait ColumnResolutionHelper, which provides methods for resolving column references, handling unresolved attributes, and managing plan-specific column resolution within Spark SQL's catalyst analysis phase.

classes.name: ColumnResolutionHelper
classes.description: A trait providing methods for resolving column references, handling unresolved attributes, and plan-specific resolution logic within Spark SQL's analysis phase.

methods.name: resolveExprsAndAddMissingAttrs
methods.description: Recursively resolves expressions and adds missing attributes to the plan, especially for unresolved or missing attributes in Sort or Filter expressions.

methods.name: resolveExpression
methods.description: Resolves an expression by top-down traversal, handling unresolved attributes, get column by ordinal, and other special cases, with optional last resort resolution.

methods.name: resolveLiteralColumns
methods.description: Resolves special literal columns like CURRENT_DATE within expressions.

methods.name: resolveOuterRef
methods.description: Resolves UnresolvedAttribute to OuterReference if applicable, based on the outer plan context.

methods.name: resolveVariables
methods.description: Resolves UnresolvedAttribute to variable references, including handling of temporary variables.

methods.name: resolveColWithAgg
methods.description: Resolves UnresolvedAttribute to TempResolvedColumn within an Aggregate plan context.

methods.name: resolveLateralColumnAlias
methods.description: Resolves lateral column aliases in select list expressions if enabled in configuration.

methods.name: resolveExpressionByPlanOutput
methods.description: Resolves an expression against a plan's output attributes, with optional throws and last resort resolution.

methods.name: resolveExpressionByPlanChildren
methods.description: Resolves an expression against a plan's children output attributes.

methods.name: tryResolveColumnByPlanChildren
methods.description: Attempts to resolve an UnresolvedAttribute by plan's children using plan id tags.

methods.name: resolveColsLastResort
methods.description: Last resort resolution: attempts to resolve columns as outer references and as SQL variables.

methods.name: resolveExprInAssignment
methods.description: Resolves expressions in assignment context, handling nested columns.

methods.name: tryResolveDataFrameColumns
methods.description: Attempts to resolve DataFrame columns using plan id tags, including handling of star expressions.

methods.name: resolveDataFrameColumn
methods.description: Resolves an UnresolvedAttribute to a NamedExpression based on plan id tags.

methods.name: resolveDataFrameColumnByPlanId
methods.description: Recursively resolves a DataFrame column by plan id, merging results and handling ambiguities.

methods.name: resolveDataFrameColumnRecursively
methods.description: Recursively searches plan tree for a plan node matching a specific plan id to resolve a column.

methods.name: resolveDataFrameStar
methods.description: Resolves star expressions (select *) based on plan id.

methods.name: resolveDataFrameStarByPlanId
methods.description: Resolves star expressions by plan id, ensuring unambiguous resolution.

methods.name: resolveDataFrameStarRecursively
methods.description: Recursively searches plan tree for star resolution based on plan id.
